name: Chikatetsu Fuusa Jiken "Naze Boku-tachi wa Koko ni Iru"
original_name: 地下鉄封鎖事件「なぜ僕たちはここにいる」
source:
Main character is a normal university student. He goes to a part-time job before Christmas and gets in a subway crash. He wakes up in a closed space with another man and four women as survivors. They strive to escape this place, but somehow things get violent with many women insulted. Will protagonist help the girls or attack them?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名普通大学生。圣诞节前，他去做兼职，途中遭遇地铁事故。醒来时，他身处封闭空间，幸存者还有另一名男子和四名女性。众人努力逃离此地，事情却不知为何逐渐变得暴力，多名女性遭到侮辱。主人公会帮助女孩们，还是转而袭击她们？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
